notes: Muse Wonder Model Card (8 pages), extracted with pdftotext -layout; every stored value was checked to appear in the extracted text. The benchmark image on page 3 (the capability table) is stored in meta-muse-wonder-launch-2026-10-12.json, where it matches the dev.meta.ai table cell for cell. This file holds section 4 risk-assessment tables, all Muse Wonder Full only: cyber capability (CyberGym 88.4%, ExploitBench 58.9%, ExploitGym 92 flags of which 21 intended), cyber robustness ASR (CyberBench, PolyGuard cyber subset, RedCode; single and multi turn), CBRN capability (SecureBio MBCT/HPCT/VCT, LAB-Bench v1, ABC Bench, Meta BDT), CBRN safety refusal (BioTIER and internal chemistry; English, Multilingual, Adversarial) and loss of control (MASK 87.3%, Agentic Misalignment 0%). No comparison models appear in section 4. Effort for these evaluations is not stated, so rows carry effort 'unknown'. Meta-authored evaluations with Meta-chosen mitigations; no third-party replication. Recheck for the promised full safety report by 2026-10-27.

claims.statement: Muse Wonder Model Card section 3: 'Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full results are generated with max reasoning effort. We compare with GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, and Claude Opus 5.5 at max reasoning effort.' For controlled internal coding comparisons every model uses the same benchmark-specific harness; external coding results keep the harness of the reporting vendor. Score selection: where a comparable third-party or provider-reported result exists Meta uses it, otherwise the highest of its internally validated run, self-reported score or official leaderboard score; refusals receive zero credit and stay in the denominator.
claims.implication: Best-available-source selection favors the publisher: treat Meta's launch-table margins as upper bounds, especially on rows where the competitor numbers are best-effort internal runs.

claims.statement: Model card section 4: under the Meta Superintelligence Scaling Framework, without mitigations Meta does not rule out the high risk threshold in Chemical & Biological and puts the unmitigated model at 'moderate or lower' for Cybersecurity and Loss of Control; with mitigations and system-level safeguards it assesses 'moderate or lower' across all domains. Section 4 results are from Muse Wonder Full only 'which is why the assessment covers every model in the family'.
claims.implication: No Muse Wonder (non-Full) safety numbers are on the card. A full report with more safety evaluations is promised ('available soon').

claims.statement: Model card section 1 and 6: release date October 12, 2026; input text, image, video and audio; output text; 1M-token context at inference; known limitations include inaccurate or biased output, errors in multi-step reasoning in novel scenarios, weak visual and spatial (especially 3D) reasoning, performance varying with quantization, serving configuration, prompts, tools and agent harness, and not intended for users under 18.
claims.implication: Provenance for the release date stored in models.json.
